content:
"* Malaysian authorities have paused the search for Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, an Indian tourist who vanished after a pavement collapsed beneath her in Kuala Lumpur, sending her into an 8-metre sinkhole.

***

Gali disappeared on 23 August while walking along a road in the Malaysian capital. Despite days of efforts, rescuers have not located her, with only her slippers recovered so far.

***

The search has used tracker dogs, remote cameras, ground-penetrating radar, high-pressure water jets, and excavators to clear debris from underground drainage areas.

***

Officials said the mission became too dangerous for rescue teams. Two divers entered the site earlier but were withdrawn before reaching an obstruction due to hazardous conditions.

***

A minister cited personnel safety and health as key reasons for the halt. Authorities also noted a soil slip had occurred at the same location last year. Is there anything else I can help with?"
